```{=html}
<section class="band band-slim band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Questions</p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream" style="padding-top:1.6rem">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <div class="faq-list">

      <details class="faq-item" open>
        <summary>What is the dress code?</summary>
        <p>We ask that guests wear formal attire. We suggest suits for men, and floor-length or
        tea-length dresses for women. If you have any questions, feel free to ask us. One practical
        note: the ceremony is on the lawn, so you may be more comfortable in block heels or flats.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Is the wedding outside?</summary>
        <p>Partly. We plan to hold the ceremony on the lawn overlooking the lake, and will move
        indoors if the weather is bad. Cocktail hour follows under a covered tent on the patio,
        weather permitting, and dinner will be inside the Inn. You are welcome to step inside at
        any point during the day.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Can I bring a guest?</summary>
        <p>Unfortunately, due to capacity limits at our venue, your invitation will name everyone
        we have saved a seat for.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Are kids welcome?</summary>
        <p>Yes &mdash; your children are welcome. If you know us, you know we love getting to be
        the big cousins to all the children in our lives. Children twelve and under will have a
        children's meal at the venue. There is also plenty for them to do nearby: the Sciencenter,
        the Ithaca Children's Garden, the Museum of the Earth, and the farmers market are all on
        our <a href="things-to-do.html">Things to Do</a> page.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>When do we need to RSVP?</summary>
        <p>Invitations go out in early spring 2027 and the RSVP deadline will be on them. You do
        not need to do anything before that.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>I have a dietary restriction, can you accommodate?</summary>
        <p>Yes. Tell us when you RSVP &mdash; there is a place for it. Our caterer handles
        vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergies routinely, and every dish at dinner is
        labelled.</p>
      </details>

      <details class="faq-item">
        <summary>Is there parking at the venue?</summary>
        <p>Yes, there is plenty of parking at the Inn if you choose to drive!</p>
      </details>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>
```
